name: accordion
title: Accordion
purpose: Coordinate a vertical collection of heading disclosures with single or multiple expansion.
avoidFor: Peer views that need tab semantics
accessibility: Composes labelled Collapsible regions under semantic headings.
ArrowUp and ArrowDown wrap focus among enabled triggers.
Home and End move to the first and last enabled trigger.
commonMistakes: Passing an array model to single mode or a string model to multiple mode.
Putting unrelated actions in disclosure headings.

examples.title: Single disclosure
examples.description: Single mode keeps one related answer open at a time.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import Accordion from "@/components/ui/Accordion.vue";
import { ref } from "vue";

const openItems = ref<string | readonly string[]>("first");
const items = [
  {
    "id": "first",
    "title": "Question placeholder 01",
    "content": "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit."
  },
  {
    "id": "second",
    "title": "Question placeholder 02",
    "content": "Sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua."
  },
  {
    "id": "third",
    "title": "Question placeholder 03",
    "content": "Ut enim ad minim veniam, quis nostrud exercitation ullamco.",
    "disabled": true
  }
];
</script>

<template>
  <Accordion id="questions-placeholder" v-model="openItems" :items="items" type="single" />
</template>
